source.label: CLN6 disease
source.summary: A rare inherited brain disease of childhood with seizures, vision loss and loss of movement and speech skills.

target.label: Lysosomal degradation (ceroid lipofuscin storage)
target.summary: Cells break down worn-out parts inside lysosomes. In all NCLs this recycling fails and waste (lipofuscin) builds up, especially in nerve cells.

supporting.quote: [MOCK] As in CLN5 disease, CLN6-deficient neurons show lysosomal storage of subunit c of mitochondrial ATP synthase.
